verdict.rationale: Canny ties feedback to identified user accounts via its SDK and captures ARR impact/deal-linking context alongside feedback, and its MCP feature lets PMs query themes and ARR impact in natural language. However, there's no direct evidence of a unified PM-facing dashboard showing rich customer context (e.g., company size, plan tier, usage data) natively surfaced next to each feedback item outside of MCP/LLM querying. Missing for 10: native in-app customer profile/context view merging CRM data with feedback, independent/hands-on validation of this prioritization workflow.
